title: Ascent through the seven hekhalot in Enoch and Merkavah texts

tellings.quote: The Book of Enoch and the Merkavah texts of ancient Jewish mystics describe an ascent through seven hekhalot, also called palaces, via the use of breathing techniques, visualization, and mantra-like prayers.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels points to the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish religious text, and the Merkavah texts, writings of ancient Jewish mystics. He says they describe a journey upward through seven 'hekhalot', meaning palaces, reached through breathing techniques, visualisation and chant-like prayers. He raises it as a sign that ancient people had practices for reaching other levels of reality.
